args.query: Tailwind CSS v4 upgrade: tailwind.config.js theme to @theme in CSS, @tailwind directives to @import, postcss plugin moved

results.title: PostCSS custom plugin plus autoprefixer with pinned browsers
results.summary: Write a PostCSS 8 plugin that resolves design tokens, converts px to rem and strips @debug rules, chain it with autoprefixer using a fixed browser list, and check prefixes, source maps and CssSyntaxError positions.

results.title: clsx, tailwind-merge and CVA button variants
results.summary: Compose class names with clsx, resolve Tailwind conflicts via tailwind-merge, and define button variants with class-variance-authority.

results.title: BeautifulSoup 4 + soupsieve CSS selector scraping
results.summary: Scrape fixture HTML with BeautifulSoup and soupsieve CSS selectors to pull table cells, links and data attributes, plus the html.parser tbody gotcha.

results.title: markdown-it render with custom plugin
results.summary: Render Markdown to HTML with markdown-it and a small custom plugin that rewrites link targets offline.

results.title: openpyxl worksheet rows validated into pydantic models offline
results.summary: Read xlsx rows from openpyxl into pydantic v2 models, handling None cells, whole-float to int coercion, whitespace, ignored extra columns and row-numbered errors, all tested offline.

results.title: Excel .xlsx export and import with ExcelJS
results.summary: Generate styled .xlsx reports (header row, number formats, formulas, frozen panes) and read uploaded workbooks back into typed rows with ExcelJS, all in memory.

results.title: CSV import with PapaParse + Zod row validation
results.summary: Parse CSV uploads with PapaParse (headers, BOM, quoted fields), validate each row with Zod and report row-numbered errors instead of failing the whole file.

results.title: Zod v4 schemas exported to JSON Schema and checked with Ajv
results.summary: Export Zod v4 schemas to JSON Schema 2020-12 with z.toJSONSchema, using .meta() ids and descriptions and input vs output modes, then validate the same data with Ajv 2020.

results.title: node-html-parser query and mutate
results.summary: Parse an HTML fixture with node-html-parser, query nodes via CSS selectors, read text and attributes, mutate with set_content, setAttribute and remove, then serialize back and assert the result offline.

results.title: sass compileString with in-memory importer
results.summary: Compile Sass from a string with dart-sass, using variables and mixins from an in-memory @use module provided by a custom canonicalize/load importer, compressed output, and an undefined-variable error assertion, all offline.
